venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Cool autumn evening, sunny all day
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 10/24 (MOD JK; entered by Daniel; posted 3:22am 10/25).** Net $8,268 vs $8,677 target (-5%). Food $440. Comps $72 (0.9%). 301 guests, $27.29 avg. Good start, big push around 10pm and steady to close. Multiple Halloween costume party groups and many birthdays. Fully staffed for the rush; keep tabs on bathroom supply stock. Guests loved Halloween cocktails, especially the zombie. 86: Peach Schnapps, High Noon, Miller High Life. No incidents.

Net ex-events $15,502.51 (D&C AM $1,973.18, PM $13,529.33). Food incl. events $4,263.40 (event food $1,680); net event sales $3,600. Comps $505.14 (3.26%). 379 guests (Tock). venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 10/24 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Steves; entered by Thomas; posted 5:20am 10/25).** Net $7,888 vs $6,658 target (+18%). Food $613, beverage $7,275. Comps $136.38. 221 guests (SevenRooms), $36 check avg. 221 covers, 8 solos, 6 large parties, 12 investor cocktails. First turn a bit lackadaisical but a 90% room all night; door ran a waitlist from ~7pm with groups of 3s and 4s, Halloweekend energy. Top sellers: Shinebox (34), Native Lion (21), chips & dip. Menu count 19. Maintenance wish: a way to retrieve phones from T1/2. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 10/24 (MOD/Chef Joe/Julian/Gigi + Saleh/Angel/Josh; entered by Gigi; posted 5:34am 10/25).** Net $12,892 vs $12,617 target (+2%). Food $2,825. Marquee $9,843 (food $2,236); Standing Room $3,049 (food $589). Comps $383.78 (DNLs, members, investors). 312 guests, $99.26 check avg (as reported). Slow, peculiar start (local concerts/Halloween events), heavy walk-ins after 8pm, campers made Marquee turns hard; SR used as a starting point for reservations. Lull ~11:30pm, SR closed ~midnight. Busy night for food. Maintenance: pests (pest control Tuesday, then biweekly). 86: vermillion rockfish. No-shows charged.

venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 10/24 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Shannon; entered by Alexis; posted 2:07am 10/25).** Net $21,998 vs $15,387 target (+43%). Municipal Bar AM $3,487, PM $15,395, Sun Club $700, Hot Eye $2,207. Food $8,900. Comps $354. Guests 445 (120 AM + 325 PM OpenTable). SCAD Film Fest underway; 12-3 non-stop between screenings, full restaurant from noon to close with a brief idle 8-8:30 as films turned over. Kitchen heavily hit (expo from noon to close), only one DNL. Low: chicken breast, burger buns (Costco run Sunday), one bag mussels. Hot Eye slower than average Saturday. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: High 54, overcast; lighter early walk-in traffic
venues.narrative: **SEA — Saturday 10/24 (MOD Curtis Hayes; posted 4:03am 10/25).** Net $11,813 vs $10,544 target (+12%). Food $1,403. Comps $189.36 (1.6%), only a couple DNLs. 101 reservations, 250 guests, $46.33 avg guest spend. Cold grey day slowed early walk-ins (suggest a patio heater); strong pace all night with waitlist worked down by 11pm. Floor ran smooth with 3 on, early cut and breaks. Maintenance: HVAC got warm around 11pm, partly from the Rational oven cleaning cycle. 86: Eagle Rare, Four Pillars Navy Strength. Met a prospective investor/member. No incidents.
